property_summary: For any actor and any amount, after a Put{value: amount} the ether held by c is exactly the credited Acc balance of that actor (c custodies exactly what it records); the mutant records nothing, so its contract balance exceeds the recorded balance.
change_summary: Delete the statement crediting msg.value to the caller's balance in Put, so Acc[msg.sender].balance no longer increases after a Put call.
